Comment: CloudLab c240g5, U11's worst case on Amazon 300M: the queries are 2M of the base's own vectors, drawn without repetition (scripts/data/sample_queries.py, seed 1), so no run repeats a query and none has any locality. They are drawn on the lab server, which has the index's layout map; their ground truth covers every 500th of the first 1M (fusion_gt --base). Set the rates from the two worst-case capacities: Rate about 0.6 x C4 (4to8-worst-calibrate-4), RateSteps 60:about 0.8 x C8 (4to8-worst-calibrate-8), the same in every protocol's file. Otherwise experiment.amazon-300m-cloudlab-gpu-4to8-copy-then-flip.json: 4 -> 8 at 90 s under copy-then-flip. The copy outlasts the load (with the QAC queries it flipped 1636-1768 s after the trigger), and the run keeps what it measured. StageTimeout 2h, as there.
